THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA: SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, Shillong, 16th September, 2026
No.HCM.11/73/2021/Estt/60: in exercise of powers conferred under Rule 7 (C) (15) of the Rules of
the High Court of Meghalaya, 2013 (Chapter-II), the High Court of Meghalaya, in terms of the
resolution adopted in the Full Court meeting held on the 10th September, 2026 is pleased to further
amend the High Court of Meghalaya Rules,2013 as under:-
Short title and
Commencement (1) These Rules may be called the High Court of IVleghalaya
Amendment Rules, 2026.
(2) This shall come into force with immediate effect
Amendment of Rule 36 in
Chapter XII After Rule 36 in Chapter XII of Part II of the Rules of High Court
of Meghalaya.2013. Rule 36A shall be inserted with the words;-
'’36A. Particulars relating to reservation, pronouncement
and uploading of judgments. Every certified copy of a
judgment or order shall indicate-
(i) the date on which the judgment or order was reserved, where
applicable;
(ii) the date on which the judgment or order was pronounced;
and
(iii) the date on which the reasoned judgment or order was
uploaded on the official website of the High Court.
By Order,
./
REGISTRAR GENERAL
